name: Child Abuse Reporting Hotline Poster
description: PDE poster with statewide toll-free numbers for reporting suspected abuse, neglect and school safety issues, posted in a high-traffic public area of each school.
recipient: Students and public in each school
quote: The Superintendent or designee shall ensure that the poster, developed by the PA Department of Education, displaying the statewide toll-free telephone numbers for reporting suspected child abuse, neglect and school safety issues be posted in a high-traffic, public area of each school.
